display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-10 Renewable Energy Valleys in Africa to increase energy security and energy access in Africa – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2027-02-D3-10 Renewable Energy Valleys in Africa to increase energy security and energy access in Africa
executive_summary: A Horizon Europe Innovation Action that funds the design, construction, commissioning and operation of a decentralised renewable energy demonstration (a 'renewable energy valley') in an urban or rural area in Africa, covering local energy needs, grid stability and grid reinforcement, a local value chain, skills and a business strategy. Consortia must include at least two beneficiaries from two different African Union member states, which are exceptionally eligible for funding, alongside the standard Horizon Europe consortium rules; projects should reach TRL 8. The topic budget is EUR 9 million, around EUR 4.5 million per project for about two projects. The call opens on 3 December 2026 and the single-stage deadline is 31 March 2027, 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: The Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme 2026-2027 (Part 8), pp. 140–142, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds the demonstration of a decentralised renewable energy system located in Africa, including local grid stability and reinforcement, local value chains and skills. No project file is close: TenneT's projects concern the Dutch and German transmission grid, while this topic concerns local African energy systems and communities whose results would not reach TenneT's grid, assets or markets. The call therefore does not touch TenneT's field and is Not relevant.
